terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A 660 L four-castor polyethylene refuse container. The lid hinges along the -X top edge (the plate shows the knuckles down its left side), so the model ships a root pivot plus ONE named lid-hinge pivot on the lid instance; the castors are moulded into the body component (a bin is pushed, not driven) and nothing attaches, so zero sockets. Behind every convenience store and condo in Bangkok. Dark green polyethylene, dusty low on the panels, zinc swivel castors with black tyres.

reasoning: ONE body component: the tapered frustum, the rim flange, five front ribs, two lifting lugs, two hinge knuckles, and four castors (tyre, hub disc, fork, swivel plate and pin) -- all merged on the plastic material.

ONE lid as a one-instance InstancedMesh: slab, hipped dome frustum, raised centre panel, eight vent slots (the inner two of each quarter, v4) and three hinge knuckles, so the lid-hinge pivot names an instance the host can rotate.
One material: green polyethylene on a white vertexColors material; lid tone, ribs, slots, tyres and zinc are vertex colours.
Action readiness: one root pivot plus lid-hinge, zero sockets, one box collider on the root, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the tapered green box on four visible castors with a hipped vented lid and ribbed front; the surface is flat plastic with light grime, so every part is a box, frustum or cylinder and no canvas beyond grime is warranted.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: tapered body widening to a flanged rim
hipped lid with a raised centre panel and vent slots on its long slopes, hinged down the -X side
five moulded vertical ribs on the lower front
four zinc swivel castors with black tyres
two lifting lugs under the front rim and hinge knuckles on the -X rim

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.94 x 1.22 x 0.78 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=2 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 1 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: Tapered frustum 0.80 x 0.66 at 0.18 m widening to 0.90 x 0.74 at 1.06 m; rim flange 0.93 x 0.77 at 1.08-1.12 m; lid slab 0.94 x 0.78 at 1.10-1.135 m with a hipped dome 0.88 x 0.72 -> 0.50 x 0.40 to 1.21 m and a raised panel 0.30 x 0.22 to 1.22 m; four castors r 0.07 at x +-0.35, z +-0.20.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -0.47..+0.47 at the lid slab over the declared 0.94 m width; z -0.39..+0.39 at the lid slab over the declared 0.78 m; y 0.00 under the castors to 1.22 at the top of the raised lid panel. Proxy occupancy (scratch/_mon/occupancy.mjs): castors 0-0.12 H at the four corners, body from 0.14 H widening 0.84 -> 0.94 W to the rim at 0.86-0.88 H, lid flat over the top. Body frustum 0.80 x 0.66 at 0.18 m to 0.90 x 0.74 under the rim; castors r 0.07 at x +-0.35, z +-0.20 -- the proxy band 0 reads 0.614 W x 0.384 D of H for the castor span, and the z station is scaled by the declared depth over the proxy's.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate, a three-quarter view. Band table: mean |delta width| 0.03, every body band within 0.03; depth reads the candidate ~0.06 deeper on every band because the declared 0.78 m (confirmed by the plate's own yaw solve, see the asset notes) beats the proxy's single-view rear. Band 0 fixed the castor span: the shipped 0.88 build had them 0.076 H too close in x.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. Confidence 0.85: a 660 L body is symmetric about X and Z except the hinge side; the rear is authored as the plain side the plate's right flank shows.

componentTree.name: Tapered body, rim, ribs and castors
componentTree.topologyRationale: One frustum, twenty-two boxes and twelve cylinders merged into one geometry on one material: one draw call.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Frustum 0.80 x 0.66 -> 0.90 x 0.74 over 0.18-1.06 m; rim flange 0.93 x 0.04 x 0.77 at 1.08-1.12 m; ribs 75 mm boxes tilted to the front slant, 30 mm proud, over 0.20-0.64 m; castors: tyre r 0.07 x 0.038 at x +-0.35, z +-0.20, hub disc r 0.038, fork, swivel plate 0.09 square under the body, pin.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The rim flange overlaps the frustum top by 2 cm all round (a slanted face is never coplanar with a vertical box); the ribs are rotated to the slant and stand 30 mm proud; the hub discs are 1 mm proud of the tyre faces; the swivel plates sit 8 mm up into the body bottom.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: One merged BufferGeometry with height UVs at 1.25 m.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Green as vertex colour on white with a grime canvas; ribs #587e5f; tyres #4e4e4e; zinc #9d9d9d.

pivot.name: root
pivot.notes: base-center at the ground under the four castors, as the asset declares. The body is the rigid root; the lid carries its own hinge pivot on the -X top edge.

collider.notes: Declared on the asset as box: the whole bin envelope.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/body.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.860. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.evidence: crops/castor.png -- black tyre on a zinc fork; tyre shipped at #4e4e4e, zinc at #9d9d9d.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-body (0.86) at #47644d (luma 89) on the lit front; carried as a vertex colour on a WHITE material, lifted to #4a6a50 so the shaded flank clears the silhouette gate on chroma and luma both. The lid (#52745c) measures #777f7c in the plate's sky light and #5e7968 on its front slope; the ribs carry a lighter #587e5f because the plate's rounded ribs catch the light along their crowns.

Castors: tyres measured near-black in the plate, shipped at #4e4e4e (luma 78) at the outline's bottom edge where they meet the background rather than being enclosed; zinc fork, plate and hub disc #9d9d9d against the plate's #c1c1c0 highlight.

Textureless as DECLARED: a 256 px grime canvas after construction, wash (0.70, 0.70, 0.64) at 0.22 over the bottom 20% -- height UVs at 1.25 m so the tile lands ONCE over the body; at 0.60 m it repeated its wash as a hard band mid-body.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: One component and one repetition system: 2 of 2.

materials.note: plastic only: 1 of 2; every tone a vertex colour.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1,228 of 2,000: one frustum, twenty-two boxes and twelve 10-18 segment cylinders in the body; the lid's slab, dome frustum, panel, eight slots and three knuckles.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Frusta for the tapered body and the hipped lid dome; boxes for the rim, ribs, lugs, knuckles, slots, forks and plates; cylinders for the tyres, hubs and pins.
One InstancedMesh: the lid, one instance, carrying the lid-hinge pivot with its instance index.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction, 0.25 MB.

risks.description: The plate's tyres are near-black; shipped at luma 78.
risks.mitigation: The tyres sit on the outline's bottom edge and are not enclosed, so the lift is smaller than the wheelie bin's; recorded on the material override.

risks.description: The proxy reads the depth ~0.14 m under the declared 0.78 m.
risks.mitigation: The asset notes derive 0.79 from the plate's own yaw; the proxy's rear is hallucinated from one view and the delta is recorded in meshyNote.
